body: Not sure this is something we can easily deal with. Basically the interface is instant and the hit template decide to show images or not (and the hit template is not on our side, it's always a user pref). So if the hit template as an tag and if the images are really big then if we both want to show results at the first keystroke and be fast then it's hard. Every solution will be some kind of delay that we wait before showing the hits, or loading the images (lazyload). But it's all based on timers. Since you cannot cancel image downloads.
